messages.subject: Re: Multilevel SEM
parts:
Are you using lavaan? This looks like an error message from the sem
package. Try this:

fit <- lavaan::sem(model = model, data = my_data, cluster = "cluster",
estimator

or make sure you have not loaded the sem package after loading the
lavaan package.

Yves.


On 06/06/2018 01:54 PM, Zahra Rasaei wrote:
> Hi,
> I am using multilevel SEM
> I have an error:
>
> Error in if ((!is.matrix(model)) | ncol(model) != 3) stop("model
> argument must be a 3-column matrix") : argument is of length zero
>
> Can you help me to solve it?
>
> My code:
>
> model <- '
>         level: 1
> # measurement model
> SPr =~ 1*SP
> depthr =~ 1*depth
>
> # structural model
> SPr ~ valley_depth + elevation
> depthr ~ elevation + aspect + slope
>
> # measurement error
> SP ~~ 0.20*SP
> depth ~~ 0.10*depth
>
> level: 2
> # measurement model
> clayr =~ 1*clay
> ECr =~ 1*EC
>
> # structural model
> clayr ~ clay_index + flow_accomulation
> ECr ~ elevation + gypsum_index
>
> # measurement error
> clay ~~ 0.30*clay
> EC ~~ 0.25*EC
> '
> fit <- sem(model = model, data = my_data, cluster = "cluster", estimator
> = "ML")
>
> Thanks.
